lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: I sure hope you're not thinking of doing something devious behind my back!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: Zeus, let me bring fire to the people!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: I can't allow for my people to suffer-

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: IT IS OUT OF THE QUESTION!!!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: And now they have to pay!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Zeus
lvl_1_1.text: Don't even think of asking me something preposterous like that ever again!

lvl_1_1.speaker: Prometej
lvl_1_1.text: Looks like I'll need to take matters into my own hands...

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: What calls your spirit to action on this lovely day?

atena_wasd.speaker: Prometej
atena_wasd.text: I want to bring fire to the people!

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: I shall guide you on your travels.

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: You can move using the "A" and "D" keys.

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: Unless you've rebind some keys in the settings...

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: In that case you should know the controls better than me.

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: I guess you're really set on your goal.

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: If you find yourself really stuck...

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: ...you can reset your level by pressing "U".

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: You can also skip a section you're struggling with.

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: Just press the "ESC" button and click on "Skip to next level!"

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: I will then help you travel across.

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: But I will help you only if you really struggle and die 7 times.

atena_skip.speaker: Atena2
atena_skip.text: You're a hero, I believe you can do this on your own.

npc_woman.speaker: Prometej
npc_woman.text: What are you doing here today?

npc_woman.speaker: Prometej
npc_woman.text: Well have a nice day then.

npc_man.speaker: Prometej
npc_man.text: Well you're holding the hammer upside down.

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: Don't you tell me how to do my job!

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: My father was a carpenter, his father too, and his father before him!

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: And they've all done this the same way for generations!

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: Just take a look at the beautiful tripod behind me that I made.

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: That I totally didn't find somewhere on the road...

npc_man.speaker: npc_man
npc_man.text: Hmmm who knows how many other items I can find around Greece that I can take home...
